factions.name: The Regency
factions.description: The regent's council, ruling in the dead king's name until the Council of Claims.

factions.name: House Marrow
factions.description: Old river-country lords. Cautious, wealthy, slow to forgive.

factions.name: House Calder
factions.description: Martial, proud hill lords with the strongest claim by blood and an army at Ashby Ford.

factions.name: House Vane
factions.description: A minor house whose holdfast guards the high road to the capital.

factions.name: House Lisle
factions.description: Merchant-princes of the southern ports who hold half the realm's debts.

factions.name: House Ostry
factions.description: Wardens of the northern marches, distant and distrusted.

factions.name: The Grey Chapter
factions.description: The realm's faith, keepers of the Book of Crowns; no ruler is lawful without their anointing.

characters.name: Regent Osric
characters.description: Osric Dunmore, the late king's chancellor, of no great house. Soft-spoken, patient, ruthless. Holds the realm by ledgers, favours and fear. Cannot die before the Council of Claims.

characters.name: Master Quill
characters.description: Keeper of the royal archive. Old, fussy, frightened, and keeping more secrets than he admits.

characters.name: Commander Ysolde Brand
characters.description: Commander of the Lantern Guard. A scarred, honest soldier who obeys the Regency and is starting to dislike what it asks.

characters.name: Queen Aveline
characters.description: The dowager queen, born a Marrow. Has worn mourning grey since her son died. Gentle in manner, lonely, sharper than people assume.

characters.name: Lady Maud Marrow
characters.description: Head of House Marrow, in her seventies. Collects debts and never forgets one. Warm to your face.

characters.name: Aurel Marrow
characters.description: Lady Maud's grandson and heir. Bookish, courteous, wants peace, and is beginning to fear his grandmother.

characters.name: Lord Edric Calder
characters.description: Claimant to the throne, the dead king's nephew. Brave, proud, easily provoked, and more honourable than his mother.

characters.name: Lady Hesper Calder
characters.description: Edric's mother, born a princess, married to Calder as the price of peace. Patient, brilliant, and willing to do anything for her son.

characters.name: Garrow Flint
characters.description: Calder's master-at-arms. Blunt, loyal to Lady Hesper to the bone, does her dirty work.

characters.name: Lord Harlan Vane
characters.description: Head of House Vane. Once served in the Lantern Guard and was close to the late king. Old knee wound, stubborn, keeps a secret he has never told his children.

characters.name: Tomas Vane
characters.description: Lord Harlan's younger son, seventeen. Quick-tongued and restless, hungry to matter, easily flattered.

characters.name: Wenna Holt
characters.description: Castellan of Vane Holdfast. Dry, practical, has run the household for thirty years and knows where everything is buried.

characters.name: Lord Orlo Lisle
characters.description: Head of House Lisle. Charming, heavy, seasick on every voyage. Treats politics as a ledger and loyalty as a price.

characters.name: Jessa Coyle
characters.description: Runs the Lisle counting-house in Tallow Market. Knows who owes whom. Friendly, precise, and never lends without collateral.

characters.name: Warden Hakon Ostry
characters.description: Warden of the Marches. Grey, weathered, few words. Distrusts the south and keeps a secret for a dead king.

characters.name: Mother Idony
characters.description: Head of the Grey Chapter at Stillwater. Calm, unbribable, and determined that law, not armies, will choose the next ruler.

characters.name: Brother Hollis
characters.description: Keeper of the Grey Chapel in the capital. Ambitious, well connected, and quietly selling Chapter influence.

characters.name: Captain Dagna Rusk
characters.description: Captain of the Tallow Company, a sellsword company the Regency has stopped paying. Loud, shrewd, loyal to her people before any lord.

characters.name: Master Lucan Fell
characters.description: The royal physician, missing since the night the king died. Precise, proud, and terrified.

characters.name: Ash
characters.description: A burned, bitter fen-guide in the north. Secretly Prince Edmer, the king's son, believed dead for five years. Call him Ash unless the player has learned who he is. Cannot die.
